title: Pharohound Oath and Scarvulpine Oath evolution items
summary: Two generic Evolution Essence items are renamed into Palmon-specific Oaths, each described as the item that mega evolves its Palmon to Stage 5.
highlights: Pharohound Oath: renamed from Evolution Essence; now described as the item that mega evolves Pharohound to Stage 5.
Scarvulpine Oath: renamed from Evolution Essence; now described as the item that mega evolves Scarvulpine to Stage 5.
